content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it rules the point underdetermined because the pressed limb was dropped.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.","room":"counts as an unanswered witness: read as applying only when the judge actually counts a verse toward a broken link, versus applying whenever a pressing is mentioned even if the result is underdetermined.","why":"The judge text rules underdetermined rather than counting a verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link, so the quotation requirement is not triggered."}
